faqs.a:
(a)
All original applications shall be accompanied by a $1,000.00 nonrefundable application
               fee to defray the cost of reviewing and evaluating the application.
(b)
The annual license fee for pawnshops shall be $5,000.00.
(c)
No fee is refundable in the event of revocation or suspension of a license.
(d)
The police department shall issue a quarterly invoice to each licensee listing the
               charges for all forms used by the police department pursuant to the state statute
               regulating pawnshops. Invoices shall be payable within 30 days.
(Code 1981, § 23-4; Ord. No. 3238, § 1, 12-18-1995)
